lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We left the Bustling Market, and now we're on wide green plains. Whoosh! Can you feel it? The wind is very strong here. Welcome to the Windy Plains! Today's sentence is: The wind is blowing. Say it with me. The wind is blowing. Great! When something is happening right now, we say is and then a word with i-n-g. The wind is blowing. The grass is moving. いま おきている ことは、is と ～ing で いうよ。 Now, phonics. Make, making. Wave, waving. Smile, smiling. Shine, shining. These words end with a quiet e. Take away the e, and add i-n-g. e で おわる ことばは、e を とって ing。 Good job! Here's a tip for windy days. If your hat flies away, shout, My hat is flying away! Let's say it together. My hat is flying away! Okay, hold on to your hats, everyone. Let's walk up the hill and look around!

I'm flying means I am flying right now. 「なにを しているの？」は What are you doing?。こたえは I'm ～ing. だよ。 Now, phonics. Ride, riding. Hide, hiding. Slide, sliding. Write, writing. Do you remember? lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we're visiting a farm on the plains. There are horses, sheep and cows. Let's watch the animals quietly. When two or more animals are doing something, we use are. Today's sentence is: The horses are eating grass. Say it with me. The horses are eating grass. Good! You can also say they. They're trotting slowly. They're means they are. ふたつ いじょうなら are、または they're を つかうよ。 Now, new phonics! Trot, trotting. Hop, hopping. Sit, sitting. Nap, napping. These words are short. They have one short vowel and one last consonant. So we double the last letter. Sit becomes s-i-t-t-i-n-g. みじかい 母音と 子音 ひとつで おわる ことばは、さいごの もじを ふたつに するよ。 Here's a tip for animal watching. When you see something cute, whisper, Aww, so cute! Let's whisper. Aww, so cute! Now, let's walk to the fence slowly. Don't run, or the horses will be scared.

lessons.teacherScript: Congratulations, everyone! It's the Picture Talk Show at the studio. Each of you will talk about one picture. A good picture talk has three parts. Rising means going up. よるの ようすも ～ing で しずかに いえるよ。 The plains have no city lights, so we can see thousands of stars. Can you find a shooting star? Now, phonics. Sleepy. Starry. These say ee.
